summary: Seven metres of roundabout island kerb; no place to stop a van.
reasons: Kerb is a roundabout circulating lane
No parking room, traffic all round
Too short, on a busy junction

drivers.seclusion: Open junction with traffic on all sides; dwellings 29 m or more away, but the spot is fully exposed.
drivers.access_and_room: The line follows the central island of a roundabout; a van would sit in the circulating lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy five-arm roundabout; a bus is circulating in the Esri image.
drivers.convention: No parked cars anywhere on the roundabout.

flags: Roundabout island: nowhere to pull out of the lane
Low-lying: about 4.5 m elevation, Toowong Creek 19 m away
Only 7 m long, shorter than a van
Slope figure is noise on a 7 m line (11% max)
